name: Ayame Haruchiyo
source:
A medical student, she is the daughter of a prestigious family and has excellent grades. She had a twin sister, but was separated from her when she was young.

[spoiler] She is Asuku's childhood friend and former fiancée. [/spoiler]

[Source [URL=http://zombilica.com/games/nienomati_iromusubi/chara_19harutiyo.html]official website profile. [/URL]]
